title: Karl Nell's revised Kardashev scale

tellings.quote: Carl Nell, who set up Army Futures Command and was, you know, um, kind of defending Grush publicly as soon as he came out and and, uh, was on the UAP task force. He talks about a different version of the Cardesev scale.

plain: Karl Nell, who Michels says helped set up Army Futures Command, served on the government's task force on UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), and publicly defended David Grusch as soon as Grusch came forward with his claims, has proposed his own version of the Kardashev scale, a way of ranking civilisations by how much energy they control. Michels brings this up himself in 2024 and says nothing about how Nell's version differs. He mentions it to show that an insider like Nell thinks seriously about advanced civilisations.
